description: This file defines the CartRepository class, which manages shopping cart state, including adding, updating, removing items, and persisting the cart state in an Android application. It interacts with CartStore for persistence and exposes methods for cart operations.

classes.name: CartRepository
classes.description: Repository class that manages the shopping cart state, including adding, updating, removing items, and persisting the cart data.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a product with specified quantity to the cart; increments quantity if product already exists.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Sets an absolute quantity for a cart item; removes item if quantity is less than or equal to zero.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart based on its product ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart and resets the stored data.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Computes and returns a summary of the cart including total quantity, subtotal, and item count.

methods.name: groupedByCategory
methods.description: Returns cart items grouped by their category, sorted by category name.
